source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole-board history (board_source.py)
methodology: A window is a comeback only when the board history shows all four: it is on this week's board, it was absent from the immediately-preceding bundle, an earlier bundle carried a genuinely-passed close date (so it really closed - board absence alone is never read as a closure), and its current listing is forward-looking. We claim only that its last run ended on closed_on and it is back now. No guessed comebacks; a missing current end date is 'ongoing', not invented.

items.title: 43rd Annual A Country Christmas Lighting Ceremony
items.blurb: The resort's annual switch-on that opens the holiday season, now in its 43rd year.

items.title: Welcome To The Black Parade Tribute Show
items.blurb: A My Chemical Romance tribute night with Hindsight Hero, timed for Halloween.

items.title: Spellbinder: Magic & Hip Hop Theater Brunch
items.blurb: A midday show pairing magic with hip hop theater, served as a brunch.

items.title: NYE: Nashville's Big Bash
items.blurb: HARDY, Little Big Town and the Red Clay Strays headline a free-form lineup to ring in the New Year. The park sits just north of the State Capitol.

items.title: Nashville Symphony: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban in Concert
items.blurb: The film screened with the orchestra playing the score live. Price is not listed.

items.title: Knockdown Professional Kickboxing
items.blurb: A night of professional kickboxing at Skydeck.

items.title: Shuckle's Corn Maze and Pumpkin Patch
items.blurb: Corn maze and pumpkin patch open weekends only. One last weekend before it closes.

items.title: Nashville Pikmin Gathering
items.blurb: A weekend meetup for Pikmin players in the park, running 10 to 6 both days.

items.title: Nash-ional
items.blurb: An exhibition event at the Fairgrounds that has drawn plenty of interest ahead of opening day.

items.title: Broadway Rave
items.blurb: A dance night aimed at musical theatre nerds, drama geeks, actors and theatre lovers.

items.title: Bedazzled and Brewed
items.venue: Caption by Hyatt Downtown Nashville - The Gulch
items.blurb: A Saturday daytime event at the Gulch hotel, bedazzling plus brewing by the name. The text offers no further detail or price.

items.title: Nashville Predators vs Washington Capitals - Golden Hall Induction
items.blurb: A home game paired with a Golden Hall induction ceremony. The text gives no price or details on who is being inducted.

items.title: MAS EDM: Halloween Rave
items.blurb: A Halloween EDM rave at Cannery Hall.

items.title: A Very Special Halloween Tribute to Panic! At The Disco
items.blurb: A one-night Halloween tribute show to Panic! At The Disco.

items.title: Nashville Zombie Crawl
items.venue: Friends in Low Places Bar & Honky-Tonk
items.blurb: A two-night Halloween bar crawl covering 10+ bars, with the ticket page flagging that sales end soon. Tickets start at $19.98.

items.title: Ghost Tours at The Hermitage
items.blurb: After-dark ghost tours at the Hermitage, listed Thursday through Saturday evenings. Three nights left on this week's calendar.

items.title: Stephanie Adlington: The Witching Hour
items.blurb: A Halloween-evening jazz set billed as the Witching Hour. Early slot, so you can still make a later party.

items.title: Nurse Blake: But Did You Die? Tour
items.blurb: A nurse-comedy touring show, listed with two entries on the same Monday night, so it may be two shows. No price stated.

items.title: Friko
items.venue: The Blue Room at Third Man Records
items.blurb: Friko plays the Blue Room at Third Man Records, a small room for a one-night show.

items.title: Owl Day
items.blurb: A three-hour morning devoted to owls at the sanctuary.

items.title: Rock & Roll Playhouse: Halloween Spectacular for Kids
items.blurb: A daytime Halloween show for kids at Basement East.

items.title: HARDY Halloween
items.blurb: Two nights of a Halloween-themed HARDY show.

items.title: North Pole Express Train Ride
items.blurb: A train ride where Santa and his elves walk through every car to visit with passengers.

items.title: Nightmares from Poe
items.blurb: Edgar Allan Poe stories staged late on the Friday before Halloween, which is the right hour for them. Tickets from $49.

items.title: Beats & BOO-zy Brunch
items.blurb: A Halloween twist on the downtown DJ party brunch, with free-flow drinks, brunch plates and spooky music from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. Costumes are encouraged, reservations are recommended, and it runs through Sunday, November 1.

items.title: Don Henry's 3rd Annual Falloween Fallies
items.blurb: A Halloween-season songwriter night hosted by Don Henry at the Bluebird, with two listed showings on the same night.

items.title: Apericena Experience
items.blurb: An Italian aperitivo-and-dinner style experience from the sandwich shop, running all winter as an exclusive listing. Tickets start at $90.

items.title: Bands of America Regional Championship
items.blurb: The area's best high school marching bands take the field. Grayline runs a shuttle from State Parking Lot 28 near the State Capitol for $20 roundtrip, which saves the stadium parking fight.

items.title: Alice Unleashed: The Alice Cooper Tribute
items.blurb: A tribute show to Alice Cooper, listed among Franklin's family-friendly events. The text gives no date, so check the event page before planning around it.

items.title: Monster Ball Adults Only Climb
items.blurb: An adults-only evening on the ropes and zip lines at the Adventure Park, with a monster theme. Good excuse to be up in the trees after dark.

items.title: Friday Pre-Halloween Party Pass Crawl
items.blurb: A party pass crawl that warms up Halloween weekend a night early. The listing says sales are ending soon.

items.title: Sheryl Underwood
items.blurb: Emmy-winning co-host of The Talk on CBS doing stand-up in a room small enough to hear her breathe. Check Zanies for the full run and showtimes.

items.title: Cosmic Charlie: Day of the Dead
items.blurb: A Day of the Dead themed night with Cosmic Charlie at EXIT/IN.
